title: IBM App Connect Enterprise 13.0.1.0 through 13.0.8.2, and 12.0.1.0 through 12.0.12.30 could allow a remote attacker to…
description: IBM App Connect Enterprise versions 13.0.1.0 through 13.0.8.2 and 12.0.1.0 through 12.0.12.30 contain a vulnerability that allows remote attackers to perform content spoofing due to improper output encoding of error messages. This issue could lead to limited confidentiality and integrity impacts but does not affect availability.
